viral_entry_complete_n7.pseudo_replication_caveat: The 7 structures comprise only 3 distinct peptides with 3 distinct affinities (PIE7 x2 at 620 nM; PIE12 x4 at 37 nM; PIE71 x1 at 410 nM). Structure-level LOO rho=0.896 (p=0.006) treats near-duplicate crystal forms as independent observations and overstates the evidence; effective sample size is 3 peptides, not 7 structures.

pooled_n10.note: pooled metrics confounded by family; cross-family transfer not supported at n=10

iplddt_spearman.note: perfect monotonic ordering (higher iplddt = tighter peptide); n=3 precludes meaningful significance

viral_entry_peptide_level_n3.note: At the peptide level, Boltz-2 iplddt orders all 3 peptides correctly; NLL does not. Headline claim downgraded from validated (p=0.006) to directionally consistent at n=3 peptides.
